appraisal_events.evidence: « dédiée plus spécialement à mon père qui était amateur, une crème au chocolat, inspiration, attention personnelle de Françoise, nous était offerte »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator notes that Françoise's artful chocolate cream, though offered to all, was dedicated especially to the father as a connoisseur, quietly marking him as a discerning, favored recipient within the family scene.

status_effects.explanation: Being singled out as the connoisseur for whom Françoise's culinary artwork was especially dedicated casts the father in a mildly distinguished light within this local scene.
